# Pre-market brief, Wed Oct 14, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:25 AM ET)

**Tone: CPI day. Futures muted; BAC charge vs BLK/MS beats; oil firm; ASML raises FY.**

1. **Futures muted ahead of CPI:** Early ET: S&P ~+0.2%, Dow ~+0.2–0.3%, Nasdaq futures flat to −0.1%. Tue S&P ~7,805 (−0.02%) on very quiet SPY volume. ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-earnings-bonds-artificial-intelligence-704d3190f0fba2908df07c85f26346ec), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/cpi-ahead-more-banks-to-report-asml-earnings--whats-moving-markets-4948277))
2. **CPI 8:30 ET (Sept):** Est. ~+0.6% MoM / ~3.6% YoY; core ~+0.2% / ~2.5% — gas is the swing. Hot headline vs cool core into Oct 28 FOMC. ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/high-gasoline-prices-expected-to-boost-us-consumer-inflation-in-september-4947970))
3. **BAC: $1.2B AML hit:** NI $6.9B, EPS $0.91; adj EPS $1.08 after $1.2B settlement ($0.17/sh). Rev $30.0B (+3%); NII $16.4B (+8%). Treasury package >$1.21B (FinCEN $1.2B; OCC $750M; OFAC $11.6M). Press noted ~4% premarket weakness. ([Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sb0657), [BAC IR](https://newsroom.bankofamerica.com/content/newsroom/press-releases/2026/10/bank-of-america-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results.html))
4. **BLK / MS beat:** BLK adj EPS $15.93; rev $7.75B (+19%); AUM ~$15.5T; Q inflows $205B ($134.5B iShares). MS EPS $3.03 on ~$20.3B rev (+12%). ([BlackRock](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/newsroom/media/press-releases/blackrock-reports-third-quarter-2026), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/14/blackrock-profit-jumps-as-resilient-markets-boost-fees.html))
5. **ASML FY raise:** Q3 sales €11.7B, GM 57.5%; FY sales €44–45B, GM ~56%; 2027–28 supply won’t fully meet AI demand. ([Yahoo/ASML](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/asml-reports-11-7-billion-050000004.html))
6. **Oil / rates / BTC:** WTI ~$95–$96, Brent >$105; 10y ~5.22%; BTC ~$83.6k (box yfinance ~8:25 ET). ([EnergyNow](https://energynow.com/2026/10/oil-prices-rise-as-attacks-on-saudi-energy-facilities-and-middle-east-tankers-heighten-supply-fears/))

**Today/week:** CPI 8:30; PPI Thu 10/15; FOMC 10/28. Earnings: NFLX ~10/20; TSLA ~10/21 AMC. ([NFLX IR](https://ir.netflix.net/investor-news-and-events/financial-releases/press-release-details/2026/Netflix-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **BLK**, swing: Record AUM + $205B Q inflows after adj EPS beat. Conf: med. Risk: CPI shock / AUM drawdown.
- **ASML**, swing: FY raise; AI demand > planned 2027–28 supply. Conf: med. Risk: US fade / China.
- **UNH**, swing: Raised 2026 adj EPS ≥$20.50 after Tue beat. Conf: med. Risk: MA/policy headlines.

**Avoid:** BAC (AML overhang); airlines (Brent >$105). Telco SpaceX avoids expire today.
